The cost of childcare has skyrocketed in recent decades. Even though the stigma of using childcare has dropped, the money alone keeps it out of reach for many parents. But many Democrats are now outright talking about what used to be a radical idea: universal childcare. Vox’s Jonquilyn Hill talks with senior policy correspondent Rachel Booth about the politics of childcare. 

Listen to the full conversation here on Vox’s YouTube channel.

snippet.description:
What This Ancient Egyptian Figure Appears To Be Doing With The Object. 

This fascinating Egyptian wall carving shows a large, decorated central object surrounded by unusual extensions, while two kneeling figures appear to interact with it. Their hand gestures and the object's distinctive shape raise intriguing questions about its purpose and symbolic meaning.

Was it a sacred object used in an ancient ritual, a ceremonial structure, or a symbol representing an important Egyptian belief? 

The detailed carvings and surrounding hieroglyphs offer a glimpse into the artistic traditions and spiritual world of ancient Egypt.

Although its exact purpose cannot be confirmed from this image alone, the scene invites us to explore the mysteries of one of history's most fascinating civilizations.
